focusedChecks: Nine focused host tests passed across twelve cases. They cover nonzero grid anchors on both decks, stopped seeking, paused-track reloads, explicit preview/Freeze/grid-edit views, immediate waveforms, queued Play, cancellation and queued launch timing.
verificationLimit: iPadOS accepted installation and launch. No later device action was taken. Erik must verify load and reload position, playhead following and uninterrupted A10X playback. R90-R93 remain open. This is not a gig-readiness claim.
acceptance: Load a prepared track on each deck. Check that the file starts at the playhead before Play.
Play and pause a track away from the beginning. Reload it. Check that the view stays at the file start.
Seek while stopped. Check that the waveform and playhead show the same position.
Play the loaded track. Check that the waveform follows the playhead without a visual jump to the grid anchor.
Check audio continuity and touch response on the A10X. Report any failure.
